body:
Well at about 2pm I received my order of fioricet via fed ex ordered from a web site.  I researched this drug and because of its availabilty, low cost and barbituate status I decided to take a try (prescribed for migraines and muscle tension).
I started with 2 tablets, after about 40 minutes I felt mild relaxation with a hint of energy (from the caffeine).  Around 3pm I decided to take 2 more, this time I broke them in half so they would dissolve quicker.  About 40 minutes later I noticed a nice sedated feeling, nothing real intense but definitely a good high. It was similar to alcohol but a much cleaner high, without the craving to drink more or the headaches and thirst.  It gives a nice warm fussy feeling, not quite as good as percocet or high doses of vicodin, but definitely pleasant.
So now I have 86 tablets left, I have read not to use this for more than 2 days in a row because it is habit forming.  I better get rid of some of these so I dont kill my liver or lose my job, but 90 pills for $60 was a real deal!   I feel it most when I walk around or move my head, it made me grin when I looked out the window and thought about normal everyday things.  This is something I should be careful with.  Overall, good experience, no sickness or upset stomach like vicodin can sometimes cause.
